She wears the referenced backpack on BOTH original padded lavender shoulder straps in the normal position. Arms rest naturally in front of her; no hands touch or obscure the bag.
Composition: genuine close wearable observation, camera a little above shoulder height looking diagonally downward from behind and to her right, rear three-quarter view with a slight partial side profile. Backpack front should be almost face-on and dominate the lower center, body approximately 50percent image height; enough right side visible for mint and yellow side pocket. Preserve exact coral/salmon rectangular front body, pale mint-green perimeter binding/top strip/upper side panels, bright yellow lower side pockets, lavender padded shoulder straps. TWO gray original short top handles fastened with the gray keeper, two original upper metal rectangular ring fittings and gray stitched attachment tabs. Horizontal coral upper front zipper with gray leather pull on viewer-left. entries.prompt:

Scene: a spacious open-air museum courtyard with quiet pale concrete walls, a large rectangular opening, simple stone paving and no artworks, logos or readable signs. A fictional adult Black man about 60 with short gray hair, plain light beige knee-length cotton coat, muted burgundy sweater, dark straight trousers and brown walking shoes walks diagonally across the courtyard. He holds BOTH original cream top handles of the referenced backpack together in his right hand naturally beside his thigh, arm straight and relaxed. No new carry strap. The bag FRONT faces camera unobstructed, remains vertical with coherent weight and slightly above ground. His other hand rests relaxed at his side.
Composition: environmental frontal/very slight front-three-quarter full-body portrait. Eye-level camera at a distance; head and both shoes visible, generous architecture and paving around him. Person about65percent image height and bag body about17percent, clear 43cm adult-relative scale. Person slightly to right of center; bag hangs to viewer-left of his body and does not overlap dark trousers, silhouetted against pale wall/paving. Calm walking moment, looking along his path rather than into camera. Mild low autumn side sunlight with realistic soft shadow, neutral color rendering and fine cloth texture.
Exact product: Himawari No.2505 BLACK external WIDTH30 HEIGHT43 DEPTH14cm. Tall rounded black backpack with TWO continuous CREAM vertical webbing bands on the front flowing into the original short cream handles, black base panel, small white Himawari wordmark precisely centered between the cream bands on upper front. Original cream handle keeper with one dark snap, original black perimeter zipper tracks and pulls on viewer-left, original black side slip pockets and black padded backpack straps behind. Preserve the exact rounded top/body proportions, material, stitching, all straps and zipper layout. The cream bands are integral to the product, not a harness on the person. No front zipper pocket, front buckles or front badge.
Constraints: keep original logo, black/cream color, shape, seams, pockets and carry construction. No invented accessories, straps, extra bag, chest belt, bottles, text overlay, readable signs, collage or watermark. Natural hands and five fingers, coherent handle grip and full-body anatomy.
